usageNotes: Use this to enumerate SDN controllers (BGP, EVPN, IS-IS, Faucet) across all remotes managed by PDM, or narrow results to specific remotes and/or a controller type via query params. By default the response reflects the pending (not yet applied) configuration; pass `running: true` to see what is actually active on nodes. Results are scoped to remotes for which the caller holds `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote_name}`, so a filtered response does not necessarily mean no controllers exist.

examples.summary: List all BGP controllers across all remotes, showing running config and any pending changes

tips: Omitting `ty` returns all controller types in one call — useful for a full SDN inventory.
The `pending` field on each returned object (when `pending: true` is passed) shows only the attributes that differ from the running config, not the full object.
A controller with `state: 'deleted'` has been marked for removal but `pvesh apply` (or equivalent) has not run yet — it is still active.
The `remote` field on each item identifies which PDM remote the controller belongs to, which maps to `Resource.Audit` privilege scope.
